locations.note: Inspector Tequila tears through Hong Kong's markets and Triad turf in this Hard Boiled sequel.
The trail crosses the Pacific to Chicago, where Tequila battles the Zakarov crime syndicate.
Tequila follows a tip to the stilt village of Tai O.

routes.name: Inspector Tequila
routes.note: Tequila hunts a dead cop's killers from Kowloon's markets to the stilt houses of Tai O, across the Pacific to a Chicago penthouse and back to a Hong Kong estate for the showdown.
